description: Entry 1: CalendarEventDetailView body evaluations on the day (per-instance store seam onDetailBodyPass).
Entry 1: prefilled draft computations on the day (seam onPrefilledDraftComputed).

Auto-windows opened on the day; seeds the window budget across relaunch.

Usage denominator: foreground sessions on the day (the launch, each return from background, and a session already running when the record was minted). Control Center / Face ID do not count.
Usage - Focus mode - available: the switch was on for a session (on at its start, or turned on during it); at most once per session, so <= sessions. The denominator of this feature's keys.
Usage - Focus mode - entered (user): the focus button in the calendar header.
Usage - Focus mode - entered (auto): rotated into landscape with landscape focus on.
Usage - Focus mode - used: a -15 / +15 pill on the current event.
Usage - Focus mode - used: End on the current event.
Usage - Focus mode - used: a note sent from the composer (not the auto-save on background or teardown).
Usage - Focus mode - used: a type pill on the idle clock.
Usage - Focus mode - abandoned: a visit left with no use and no done.
Usage - Focus mode - left (every settled visit): swiped the surface away.
Usage - Focus mode - left (every settled visit): rotated back to portrait.
Usage - Focus mode - left (every settled visit): ended without a gesture (landscape focus went off, Focus was archived, or a dismissal recovered on foreground).
Usage - Focus mode - foreground dwell per settled visit, buckets <3 s / <30 s / <300 s / >=300 s.
Usage - Focus: the confirm-before-tracking preview - entered (user): a type pill with confirm-before-tracking on.
Usage - Focus: the confirm-before-tracking preview - done: Begin.
Usage - Focus: the confirm-before-tracking preview - abandoned: a visit left with no use and no done.
Usage - Focus: the confirm-before-tracking preview - foreground dwell per settled visit, buckets <3 s / <30 s / <300 s / >=300 s.
Usage - Event detail - entered (user): a block or all-day bar on the calendar.
Usage - Event detail - entered (user): View details / Log in the block's floating menu.
Usage - Event detail - entered (user): a row in the list view.
Usage - Event detail - entered (user): a search result or occurrence row.
Usage - Event detail - used: type, duration, repeat, name or edit.
Usage - Event detail - used: completion, effort, tags, note or template.
Usage - Event detail - used: a timeline note added, edited or deleted.
Usage - Event detail - used: a todo done, released, deadline or returned to the stack.
Usage - Event detail - used: delete confirmed.
Usage - Event detail - viewed: the reflection page shown (not a use).
Usage - Event detail - abandoned: a visit left with no use and no done.
Usage - Event detail - foreground dwell per settled visit, buckets <3 s / <30 s / <300 s / >=300 s.
Usage - New event - entered (user): a drag on empty canvas.
Usage - New event - entered (user): the + in the calendar header.
Usage - New event - entered (user): the resume-draft banner.
Usage - New event - entered (user): Add to schedule on a reminder (the form opens after the AI).
Usage - New event - done: Done in the new-event form.
Usage - New event - done: a done whose event repeats (subset of done).
Usage - New event - done: a done whose event is all-day (subset of done).
Usage - New event - done: a done whose event has a note (subset of done).
Usage - New event - abandoned (a visit with no done): Cancel without Done.
Usage - New event - abandoned (a visit with no done): dismissed without Done: swiped down, or a tap outside the half sheet.
